title: Pure Simorgh
summary: Pure Simorgh Tribute Summon strategy combining WIND and DARK Winged Beasts with Spell and Trap suppression and free GY revives. The small birds swarm the board whenever the opponent's backrow is clear, feeding high-Level avian lords that lock down card setting and spin opposing cards.

summary.title: Starters
points: Simorgh, Bird of Bringing adds any Simorgh card from your Deck to your hand on Normal Summon, and revives itself from the GY while your opponent controls no cards in their Spell and Trap Zone.
Simorgh, Bird of Perfection reveals itself in hand to perform an extra Normal Summon of a Simorgh monster, and sends a Simorgh monster from Deck to GY when you Normal Summon a Winged Beast.
Simorgh, Bird of Beginning grants an additional Normal Summon of a Simorgh monster during the turn it is Normal Summoned, and revives itself from the GY when the opponent's backrow is clear.
Simorgh, Bird of Calamity sends a Simorgh card from your Deck to the GY on Normal Summon, setting up GY recursion.
Elborz, the Sacred Lands of Simorgh reduces the tribute required for WIND Winged Beasts by 1 and grants an additional Normal Summon of a Winged Beast.

summary.title: Opening: Bird of Bringing + Bird of Beginning
steps: Normal Summon Simorgh, Bird of Beginning to grant an additional Normal Summon of a Simorgh monster this turn.
Normal Summon Simorgh, Bird of Bringing and activate its effect to search Elborz, the Sacred Lands of Simorgh.
Activate Elborz, the Sacred Lands of Simorgh to reduce the tribute requirement for high-Level WIND Winged Beasts.
Tribute Summon Simorgh, Lord of the Storm or Simorgh of Darkness using your field presence.
While your opponent controls no Spells or Traps, trigger the small Simorgh birds in your GY to Special Summon themselves back to the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Simorgh, Lord of the Storm cannot be targeted by opponent's Spell and Trap effects, and whenever a Spell or Trap card or effect is activated, tributes a WIND Winged Beast as a Quick Effect to shuffle 1 card your opponent controls into the Deck.

Dark Simorgh prevents your opponent from Setting any cards on the field, locking them out of face-down monsters and all Set Spells and Traps, and summons itself from hand or GY by banishing 1 DARK and 1 WIND monster.
Simorgh of Darkness Special Summons itself from the hand or GY whenever you Tribute Summon a DARK or WIND monster, and tributes a Winged Beast to negate and destroy an activated Spell or Trap Card.
Simorgh, Bird of Ancestry treats WIND Tribute Summons as requiring 1 fewer tribute and returns up to 2 cards your opponent controls to the hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Simorgh Onslaught discards 1 Winged Beast monster to search 2 Simorgh monsters with different Attributes from your Deck.
Simorgh Repulsion discards 1 Winged Beast monster to return all cards in your opponent's Spell and Trap Zones to the hand.
Simorgh Sky Battle prevents your opponent from targeting your Winged Beast monsters for attacks or card effects, and bounces cards when you control two or more high-Level Simorgh monsters.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Simorgh, Bird of Sovereignty is Forbidden in the TCG, so the Extra Deck relies on generic Rank 4s and Link Monsters.
